documents.title: COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.
COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Modis Navnirman Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance with revenue from operations growing 27.92% year-on-year to INR58.26 crores and EBITDA rising 14.25% to INR11.65 crores. Management highlighted an asset-light redevelopment model focused on micro-markets across Mumbai, adding Neel Kiran Society in Santacruz West during the quarter. The company has six ongoing projects, fourteen completed projects, and five upcoming projects in its portfolio, maintaining steady execution and healthy demand across its residential projects. Modis Navnirman Limited reported a strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations increasing by 27.9% year-on-year to ₹58.26 crore, EBITDA growing by 14.2% to ₹11.65 crore, and PAT rising by 25.8% to ₹8.54 crore. Management highlighted steady construction progress across key ongoing projects and the successful securing of a new redevelopment project during the quarter.

guidance.claim: Management expects healthy margins of around 20% to 30% in every project.
guidance.quote: But a healthy margins of around 20% to 30% should be expected in every project.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's portfolio stands at 25 premium residential projects comprising six ongoing, 14 completed, and five upcoming projects.
capex_expansion.quote: Together with this, currently we have six ongoing projects and 14 completed projects, and five upcoming projects across Bombay and its region, taking our portfolio to 25 premium residential projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully secured another new redevelopment project during Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The quarter marked another important milestone for the Company with the successful securing of another new redevelopment project.

capex_expansion.claim: Upcoming projects include Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold which were recently acquired.
capex_expansion.quote: Upcoming projects include Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold which we have recently acquired.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that material and labor cost challenges have now stabilized.
margins_costs.quote: So, a little hit has been gone on that side, but that has stabilized now.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations increased by 27.9% to ₹58.26 crore in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: “Modis Navnirman Limited delivered a strong performance in Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations increasing by 27.9% to %58.26 crore, while EBITDA grew by 14.2% to X11.65 crore and PAT rose by 25.8% to X8.54 crore, reflecting disciplined execution, operational efficiency, and the strength of the Company's redevelopment-led business model.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin was 23.62% in Q1 FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: Rashmi Square has completed 22 slabs, Rashmi Signature completed its 20th slab, Rashmi Delight completed its 14th slab, and Rashmi Manorath completed its 13th slab.
orders_capacity.quote: Rashmi Square has completed 22 slabs. Rashmi Signature completed its 20th slab. Rashmi Delight completed its 14th slab, and Rashmi Manorath completed its 13th slab.

orders_capacity.claim: Rashmi Signature is nearly 50% sold off, and Rashmi Delight is around 40% sold off.
orders_capacity.quote: Rashmi Signature has been nearly sold off 50%. Then goes Rashmi Delight, Rashmi Delight has nearly gone around 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: Rashmi Manorath sales are nearly around 20% to 25%.
orders_capacity.quote: And other than that Manorath, Manorath sales is nearly around at 20%-25%.

orders_capacity.claim: The total project portfolio consists of 7.5 lakh square feet, out of which 4.92 lakh square feet is booked and 2.40 lakh square feet is available inventory.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total project portfolio consists of 7.5 lakh square feet, out of which 4.92 is booked and 2.40 lakh available inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: The company remains debt-free despite rapid growth.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still debt-free despite rapid growth. We continue to maintain our debt-free model.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated it remains focused on accelerating project execution, selectively expanding the redevelopment portfolio, maintaining financial discipline, and delivering sustainable value.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we remain focused on accelerating project execution, selectively expanding our redevelopment portfolio, maintaining financial discipline, and delivering sustainable value for all stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets to hand over Rashmi Square to the society in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We will be delivering that project in FY27. This year we'll be delivering Rashmi Square.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects profit margins to bounce back to previous levels.
management_commitments.quote: No, no, we'll bounce back to our previous levels.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
